note: Compile vanilla-extract static styling-data modules independently of their script suffix, sharing theme contracts, native API values, deterministic variable references and later-wins static composition. Modules that also hold unrelated runtime or JSX code evaluate only the code a styling value needs, and values imported through other modules, barrels and namespaces are read exactly, including through type assertions written as `as` or `<T>`. Preserve registered selector identities independently of declaration atoms, and capture default, aliased and forwarded module exports without replaying initializers. Align theme.css source resolution between evaluation and the import graph, map consumer contract leaves and theme overloads to their real values, return the quoted generated family from fontFace, enumerate styleVariants keys like vanilla-extract, and stop self-cyclic theme contracts instead of hanging; fontFace and globalFontFace no longer trap the WASM. Report located build errors (file, line, column, cause and fix) for unknown, forward, erased or nondeterministic static inputs, native values or helpers that escape their exact initialization slice, mutated or aliased inputs, unrepresentable captures, non-object theme tokens, mismatched theme contracts, invalid non-final fallback variables, invalid global theme variable names and an authored fontFamily inside fontFace instead of emitting incomplete or malformed CSS.
